source.author: verg
source.text: Etiam tu, siqua tibi vis, si patrii quid Martis habes, illum aspice contra, qui vocat.
source.text_original: Etiam tu, siqua tibi vis, / si patrii quid Martis habes, illum aspice contra, / qui vocat.'
source.text_english: You too, if you have any strength, if you have anything of your fatherland’s Mars in you, look straight at that man who is calling you.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: patet campus, stat e contra acies, aduersarii dogma manifestum est et ut Uergilianum aliquid inferam illum aspice contra, qui uocat: respondeant aliter, teneant modum in disputando et me, in libris suis quid uel praetermiserim uel addiderim, doceant.
reuse.text_original: patet campus, stat e contra acies, aduersarii dogma manifestum est et — ut Uergilianum aliquid inferam — illum aspice contra, qui uocat: respondeant aliter, teneant modum in disputando et me, in libris suis quid uel praetermiserim uel addiderim, doceant.
reuse.text_english: The field is open; the battle line stands opposite; the adversary’s doctrine is manifest. And, to bring in something from Virgil, look at that man over there, who calls out: let them reply differently, let them keep to moderation in disputation, and let them teach me, in their books, what I have either omitted or added.
